result.markdown: --- title: "[embedding.EmbeddingOllama]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-class}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Creates an embedding function provider backed by a local Ollama server. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_embedding_ollama.py#L6-L80){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.CLASS} ```python embedding.EmbeddingOllama( model="nomic-embed-text", base_url="http://localhost:11434/v1", api_key=None, batch_size=20 ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Implements the [EmbeddingProvider](`raghilda.EmbeddingProvider`) interface. Ollama exposes an OpenAI-compatible API, so this provider is a thin wrapper around [EmbeddingOpenAI](`raghilda.embedding.EmbeddingOpenAI`) with defaults suited to a local Ollama install. Using it instead of `EmbeddingOpenAI` with a custom `base_url` means stores can be reconnected without an `OPENAI_API_KEY` in the environment. Pull an embedding model before using it (e.g., `ollama pull nomic-embed-text`). Browse available embedding models at [ollama.com/search](https://ollama.com/search?c=embedding). ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [model]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["nomic-embed-text"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The Ollama embedding model to use. Default is "nomic-embed-text". [base_url]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["http://localhost:11434/v1"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The base URL for the Ollama server's OpenAI-compatible API. Default is "http://localhost:11434/v1". Change this when Ollama runs on another machine or port. [api_key]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The API key sent with each request. Ollama does not check it, so this is only needed when the server sits behind a proxy that requires one. If None, a placeholder value is used. [batch_size]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[20]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The number of texts to process in each batch when calling the API. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#5f851d77 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from raghilda.embedding import EmbeddingOllama provider = EmbeddingOllama(model="nomic-embed-text") embeddings = provider.embed(["hello world", "testing embeddings"]) print(len(embeddings)) print(len(embeddings[0])) # Dimension of the embedding ``` :::
